verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no stagewise training opt-out, no-training policy, or data-retention commitment for its managed inference service. Local models via Ollama/LM Studio and BYOK routing that bypasses the managed service are adjacent routing controls, not a documented capability to stop data being used for training. A community user also reports finding no documentation of what data is sent to the LLM.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
